prompt:
REDESIGN: Full-bleed, high-end CINEMATIC Indian travel homepage for 'BharatVista Tours & Travels' (Tagline: 'हर सफ़र एक नई कहानी'). Inspired by the emotional visual storytelling of MP Tourism and premium global travel publications, anchored in the official BharatVista logo.

BRAND PALETTE (from logo):
- Primary Royal Navy: #0A2E4C
- Deep Midnight Shadow: #061727
- Sunset Saffron Accent: #EA580C
- Temple Gold: #D97706
- Kerala Emerald: #047857
- Sandstone Terracotta: #C2410C
- Warm Ivory Surface: #FAFAF8

HERO SECTION (MAJOR CINEMATIC ARCHITECTURE):
- 100vh full-screen cinematic video viewport. A continuous looping journey through India (Himalayas, Leh-Ladakh, Rajasthani desert forts, Khajuraho temples, Mysuru Palace, wildlife sanctuaries, Kerala backwaters).
- Header: Transparent overlay header directly above the video. Left: PROMINENT official BharatVista logo (featuring the illustrated India map with monuments, bold 'Bharat' navy, 'Vista' saffron with location pin, and 'Tours & Travels' subtext). Center: Refined navigation links (Explore, Destinations, Tours, Experiences, Stories, About). Right: High-contrast Sunset Saffron 'Plan My Trip' CTA button.
- Hero Overlay & Typography: Atmospheric gradient scrim for pristine text contrast without masking the footage. Headline: 'Discover India, Your Way' in grand editorial Playfair Display (64px). Tagline badge: 'हर सफ़र एक नई कहानी' with saffron halo. Dynamic location indicator badge ('Currently gliding over: Thar Desert, Rajasthan • 26.9124° N'). Dual CTAs: Saffron filled 'Explore Tours' and refined frosted glass 'Plan My Trip'. Downward ambient scroll indicator.

PAGE STRUCTURE & SCROLL STORYTELLING:
1. Compact Floating Trip Planner: Elegantly docked at the base of the hero. Minimalist 4-field bar: 'Where in India?' | 'When?' (Month/Season) | 'Travellers' | 'Travel Style' | Saffron 'Plan My Trip' button.
2. Section 01: 'Explore India': Large-scale panoramic thematic experiences with horizontal visual momentum (Heritage & Living Palaces, Pristine Wilderness & Tigers, Sacred & Ancient Rivers, High Himalayan Passes, Living Culture & Cuisine, Epic Road Journeys).
3. Section 02: 'Places That Stay With You': Full-bleed destination reveals for Ladakh, Rajasthan, Kerala, Varanasi, and Meghalaya with climate tags, best season indicators, and evocative narrative captions.
4. Section 03: 'Experiences': Immersive split-screen and interactive panels showcasing behind-the-scenes travel (e.g. Dawn boatman stories in Kashi, Royal desert campfires, Private tea estate walks in Munnar).
5. Section 04: 'Every Place Has A Story': Editorial magazine spread with rich dual-column typography, artisan portrait photography, and intimate travel vignettes.
6. Section 05: 'Journeys Made For You': Handcrafted tour discovery cards with duration pills, route waypoints, and dual actions ('Explore Tour' & 'Plan My Trip'). Designed for CMS/backend population.
7. Section 06: 'How Your Journey Begins': Kinetic 4-step roadmap (01 Discover → 02 Plan → 03 Connect → 04 Travel).
8. Section 07: Final Cinematic Full-Width CTA: 'Your next story starts here.' over a breathtaking dusk vista with primary 'Plan My Trip' CTA.
9. Footer: Prominent BharatVista branding, bilingual tagline, comprehensive directory links, 24/7 concierge numbers, and trust credentials.

All components structured for future dynamic CMS integration (video URLs, destination data, itinerary details).
